name: glucoseiq
description: TypeScript packages for CGM analytics, SVG rendering, React bindings, and test fixtures.
author: Mark Learst

scripts.test:docs: turbo run build --filter=@glucoseiq/core --filter=@glucoseiq/react --filter=@glucoseiq/tokens --filter=@glucoseiq/testing --filter=@glucoseiq/cli && pnpm --filter docs test:site && pnpm --filter docs test:home && pnpm --filter docs test:image && node --test scripts/doc-snippet-contracts.unit.test.mjs scripts/doc-snippet-contracts.test.mjs && node scripts/test-doc-snippets.mjs
scripts.test:packages: node scripts/package-contract-helpers.test.mjs && turbo run build --filter=@glucoseiq/core --filter=@glucoseiq/react --filter=@glucoseiq/tokens --filter=@glucoseiq/testing --filter=@glucoseiq/cli && node scripts/test-package-contracts.mjs
scripts.test:packages:candidate: node scripts/package-contract-helpers.test.mjs && turbo run build --filter=@glucoseiq/core --filter=@glucoseiq/react --filter=@glucoseiq/tokens --filter=@glucoseiq/testing --filter=@glucoseiq/cli && node scripts/test-package-contracts.mjs --source candidate
